stem:
The lengths of two line segments are shown.

1 1/2 in.

2 1/2 in.

Use the ruler provided to measure the length of a third line segment to the nearest 1/2 inch.

[Image of a line segment with length to be measured]

Which statement is true about these three line segments?

options.label: F
options.text: These line segments can form a triangle, because each side of the triangle can be a different length.

options.label: G
options.text: These line segments can form a triangle, because the longest side of the triangle can be exactly 4 inches long.

options.label: H
options.text: These line segments cannot form a triangle, because at least two sides of the triangle must be the same length.

options.label: J
options.text: These line segments cannot form a triangle, because the longest side of the triangle must be shorter than 4 inches.

visual_elements: Line segment to measure with ruler
